title: Restore themed, fully-prefilled default products and draft-version safety

requirements.summary: Replace the three default products with the previously selected themes and fully prefilled starter content so all three can be generated immediately on first launch.
acceptanceCriteria: On a fresh browser profile (no localStorage drafts), the Product Editor loads with three products whose themes are Digital Planner, Canva Templates, and Printable Wall Art.
Each of the three defaults contains non-empty starter content for: modules/chapters, prompts, templates, and checklists (not just name/description).
Clicking “Generate All Products” successfully produces 3 bundles and navigates to the Export screen with all three bundles available for download.

file_operations.description: Introduce a single source of truth for the app’s three default ProductEntry objects, populated with complete starter content for the Digital Planner, Canva Templates, and Printable Wall Art themes (name, subtitle, description, non-empty modules/chapters, AI prompts, templates, and checklists).

Use the new default products source (instead of the current placeholder defaults) so first launch loads the three themed, fully-prefilled products; keep IDs as product-1/product-2/product-3 so existing cover mapping and generation/export flows continue to work.

Confirm the product-1/product-2/product-3 cover mapping remains correct for the restored default themes and aligns with the generated asset filenames under frontend/public/assets/generated/ to ensure covers render in ExportScreen and are included in ZIPs.

requirements.summary: Prevent older saved local drafts from overriding the updated defaults by bumping local draft storage version/key and treating older drafts as incompatible.
acceptanceCriteria: If a user has older saved drafts from the previous default products, the app does not load those drafts over the new default themes; instead it starts from the new defaults.
Newly saved drafts persist and reload correctly after a page refresh.

file_operations.description: Bump the localStorage draft STORAGE_VERSION and update the STORAGE_KEY (versioned key) so older drafts are ignored; keep/strengthen the existing version mismatch fallback behavior to return empty drafts and start from the new defaults.

Ensure the workspace’s draft load/merge logic cleanly falls back to the new defaults when loadDrafts() returns empty due to an incompatible version/key, while continuing to save and reload newly created drafts correctly.
